newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Volker Stevin sees higher 1996 net.
newsitem.headline: Volker Stevin sees higher 1996 net.

text.p: Construction firm Koninklijke Volker Stevin NV said on Wednesday it expected a significantly higher profit for the full year 1996.
"We expect the profit over the full year of 1996 to be significantly higher than the profit over 1995 (58.4 million guilders)," it said in its semi-annual report.
Volker Stevin said net profit per share would be at least 15 percent higher over the full 1996, taking into account a modest conversion of subordinated bonds.
In the first six months of 1996 the number of Volker Stevin shares rose by 170,000, of which 147,500 as the result of 1995 stock dividend and the rest of bond conversion.
"Annual turnover will be about equal to 1995 (2.8 billion guilders)," it said.
Net profit over the first six months rose to 16.1 million guilders from 10.3 million in the year-ago period, largely as a result of the sale of Volker's environmental activities.
